summary: Frontend-only verification of the Attack Chain / Attack Graph visual redesign (AttackGraphTab.jsx). Tested live via the public preview URL with admin@nivxray.com. The requested test incident 36d8cd4d-a6b8-42b5-8106-1daf05a7d0ed has only ONE node in views.activity_graph (verified against the API: 21 graph nodes / 6 edges but activity_graph = 1 incident node, 0 edges), so I located a dense scene (inc_r36_edr_514098d418dd — 12 activity nodes / 11 edges / primary_path 9) and ran the full visual + regression sweep there. VERIFIED: compact nodes (rect width=156 height=46 rx=3 on every node), data-node-role on every node group in {context,telemetry,activity}, 3-letter glyph badges (INC/HST/USR/NET/HSH/EVT/SIG/PRC/CMD), dominant primary label, footer state dot + '· ev N' evidence count; restrained palette — the ONLY node fills present are #0b1220 / #0b1a2c / #1a1408 (no rainbow #831843/#134e4a/#1e3a8a/#78350f/#7c2d12/#4c1d95/#166534 anywhere); data-edge-class on every edge (causal + evidence observed), causal non-primary edges carry marker-end=url(#nx-arrow-causal), primary edges carry data-edge-primary='true' + marker-end=url(#nx-arrow-primary); anchors recede — non-primary context nodes render style opacity 0.82 while telemetry/activity stay at 1.0; primary nodes carry data-node-primary='true' + filter=url(#nx-primary-glow) + the #fbbf24 amber ring; progression banner [xdr-ag-progression-banner] visible directly above the canvas with the exact rider 'Evidence-backed causal chain — correlation NEVER implies causality'; legend toggle reveals [xdr-ag-legend] with all four semantic swatches (causal dash='0' + arrowhead marker url(#nx-legend-arrow-causal), evidence dash='0' no marker, correlation dash='5 3', gap dash='2 4') plus the full EDGE_SEMANTICS list; ONE inspector only ([xdr-ag-inspector], 0 role=dialog modals) opens on node click and on edge click (edge view shows rel, state, reason, endpoints and clickable evidence refs). Payload untouched: GET /api/incidents/{id}/attack-graph -> 200 and graph.primary_path/nodes/edges/views.activity_graph/metrics still drive everything. Regression green: Process Tree sub-view, Path Replay (0/6 -> next 1/6 -> play 2/6 -> prev 1/6, replay focus ring present), zoom in 100->115 / out ->100 / fit / reset, timeline scrub dims edges, [xdr-ag-metrics] footer, Pop Out overlay open+close, ZERO console errors, and `yarn build` succeeds with no errors. Backend untouched (git status shows only AttackGraphTab.jsx + memory/ROADMAP.md modified) so no backend pytest run was needed for this frontend-only change. ONE HIGH defect found: the honest empty state is unreachable dead code.

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH — [data-testid=xdr-ag-empty] can NEVER render. The `layout` useMemo returns null when visibleNodes.length === 0 (line 373) but the empty-state JSX is guarded by `layout && visibleNodes.length === 0` (line 999), which is a contradiction. Reproduced live: on inc_r36_edr_514098d418dd I unchecked all 7 layer toggles -> counter reads '0/53 nodes · 0/42 edges', 0 node elements in the SVG, and the canvas is a completely BLANK dark rectangle with no 'NO EVIDENCE-BACKED ATTACK CHAIN' text. Fix: change the guard to `{visibleNodes.length === 0 && (...)}` and use `(layout?.width || 800) - 40` for the rect width.

MEDIUM — label overflow / badge collision. nodeLabel() truncates at 26 chars (line 201-204) but the label box is only ~122px wide (x = p.x+34 inside a 156px node) at fontSize 11, i.e. ~16 chars. On the incident node the label 'inc_r36_edr_514098d418dd' runs UNDER the amber finding-count badge drawn at (p.x+NODE_W-9, p.y+9) and past the rect edge — it renders as 'inc_r36_edr_514098d4(4)dd'. Reduce truncation to ~15-16 chars, or add a clipPath / textLength, and reserve the top-right badge zone.

LOW — edges are painted before nodes and are routed straight through the node columns, so node rects sit on top of them. Hit-tested every edge midpoint with document.elementFromPoint: 4 of 6 sampled midpoints resolve to a NODE, and clicking there selects that node instead of the edge (only 2/6 edge clicks actually selected the edge). Add a transparent wide hit stroke (e.g. a duplicate path with stroke='transparent' strokeWidth=10) and/or offset routing so causal edges stay clickable.

issues: Timeline scrub at its first step dims ALL 11 edges to opacity 0.10 simultaneously, so the graph momentarily reads as having no relationships at all. Pre-existing behavior — confirm the window granularity is intended.

On this dense incident 9 of 12 nodes are on graph.primary_path, so nearly every node carries the amber ring + glow and 'primary path dominance' loses contrast. Data-driven, not a code defect, but consider capping the ring weight when >70% of nodes are primary.
Node footer '● OBSERVED' + '· ev N' at 8.5px in #94a3b8/#a3906a on the near-black fills is borderline low contrast at 100% zoom.

action_items: HIGH: fix the unreachable empty state — replace `layout && visibleNodes.length === 0` with `visibleNodes.length === 0` (and `(layout?.width || 800) - 40`) so 'NO EVIDENCE-BACKED ATTACK CHAIN' actually renders when zero nodes are visible. This is the one brief invariant that currently FAILS.
MEDIUM: shorten nodeLabel truncation (or clip the text) so long labels no longer overflow the 156px node and collide with the finding-count badge.
LOW: give edges a transparent wide hit stroke so causal edges remain selectable where node rects overlap them.

INFO: no incident in the seeded data has mitre/finding/gap-role nodes or correlation/gap-class edges inside views.activity_graph, so ROLE_TONE.mitre/finding/gap fills, the ATT&CK pill and the dashed/dotted edge classes could only be verified by code review + the legend swatches. If you want live proof, seed one incident whose activity_graph contains a technique node, a CORRELATED_WITH edge and a PIVOTED_TO gap edge.
critical_code_review_comments: AttackGraphTab.jsx is now 1234 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. The layout engine, edge/node renderers, LegendSwatch, replay controls and the inspector pane are all separable modules.
Empty-state guard contradicts the layout memo (see HIGH defect) — classic unreachable-branch bug; a single unit/e2e assertion on all-layers-off would have caught it.

data-testid namespace collision: the finding-count annotation group used `xdr-ag-node-annot-${id}`, which matched the `[data-testid^=xdr-ag-node-]` selector the brief mandates and produced 18 'nodes' for 12 real nodes with null data-node-role. I renamed it to `xdr-ag-finding-badge-${id}` (test-scope fix, no behavior change) — keep new testids out of the node prefix.
KIND_TONE is retained 'for API back-compat' but is only consumed by the legend; it duplicates ROLE_TONE mappings 17 times. Derive it from NODE_ROLE + ROLE_TONE instead of hand-maintaining both.

success_rate.backend: not tested (frontend-only change; no backend file modified)
success_rate.frontend: 92% (12/13 brief invariants verified; empty state fails)

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only testing; no data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tab deep-link is ?tab=attack_graph (underscore) — ?tab=attack-graph silently falls back to Executive. Default sub-view is Process Tree; click [data-testid=xdr-ag-subview-activity] for the SVG canvas. Use incident inc_r36_edr_514098d418dd for a DENSE activity graph (12 nodes / 11 edges / 9-node primary path); 36d8cd4d-a6b8-42b5-8106-1daf05a7d0ed has only the INC node in views.activity_graph. To reproduce the empty-state defect, uncheck all 7 layer checkboxes inside [data-testid=xdr-record-attack-graph] — counter goes 0/53 and the canvas is blank with no xdr-ag-empty node. The finding-count badge testid is now xdr-ag-finding-badge-{nodeId} (was xdr-ag-node-annot-*).
rca_of_the_issue: Empty state: `const layout = useMemo(() => { if (!graph || visibleNodes.length === 0) return null; ... })` (line 372-373) makes `layout` null exactly in the situation the empty state is meant to cover, while the render guard at line 999 requires `layout` to be truthy AND visibleNodes to be empty — mutually exclusive, so the <g data-testid='xdr-ag-empty'> block is dead code and the SVG renders at its 800x300 fallback size with nothing in it. Label overflow: char-based truncation (26 chars) is not width-aware for an 11px sans label constrained to ~122px, and the finding badge is drawn at the top-right of the same 156px rect with no reserved gutter.
